integrity: All reference claims are limited to inspected accessible material; finite experiments corroborate the proof but are not used as infinite certificates. No independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover smaller rims, arbitrary graph joins, or the ambient-metric partial-isometry monoid of the rim cycle. Generality established by a self-contained proof; finite checks alone do not prove the all-n result. No independent publication-priority or mathematical audit.
scientific_scope: All metric partial isometries of the labeled wheel K_1 join C_n for every integer n >= 5; full domain-rank polynomial and exact noncanonical hub-map polynomial.
title: A finite-rank hub correction for wheel partial-isometry monoids
